title: Connected-fibre charts for a flat geometrically reduced family
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Assume that for each $s\in S$ the scheme-theoretic fibre $X_s$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is geometrically reduced over $\kappa(s)$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. There is an etale covering $\{a_i:U_i\to X\}_{i\in I}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and factorizations $f\circ a_i=r_i\circ q_i$, where $r_i:V_i\to S$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and $q_i:U_i\to V_i$ is flat and of finite presentation (locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and quasi-separated, meaning its diagonal is quasi-compact). Every fibre of $q_i$ is geometrically connected and geometrically reduced over its residue field [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible].

theorem exists_etaleCover_factorization {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [GeometricallyReduced f] :
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (U : ι → Scheme.{u}) (p : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X) (V : ι → Scheme.{u})
      (q : ∀ i, U i ⟶ V i) (r : ∀ i, V i ⟶ S),
      (∀ i, Etale (p i)) ∧ (∀ x : X, ∃ (i : ι) (y : U i), (p i).base y = x) ∧
      (∀ i, Etale (r i)) ∧ (∀ i, Flat (q i)) ∧ (∀ i, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (q i)) ∧
      (∀ i, QuasiCompact (q i)) ∧ (∀ i, QuasiSeparated (q i)) ∧
      (∀ i, GeometricallyConnected (q i)) ∧ (∀ i, GeometricallyReduced (q i)) ∧
      (∀ i, q i ≫ r i = p i ≫ f) :=
